usedFor: Shopify holds your products, and Contentstack receives a content entry for each through “Create Content Entry”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Content Entry” in Contentstack
bestTemplate.why: Each new product starts a content entry that can be saved and published to your site or app.

watchOut: “Update Content Entry” changes an existing entry, so “New Product” only suits “Create Content Entry”.
